rows.name: Adobe Premiere desktop (full subscription product)
rows.reason: The full desktop product requires a subscription after a seven-day trial, so it fails the requirement for a free editing tool.

rows.name: DaVinci Resolve
rows.reason: DaVinci Resolve's free edition documents trimming, assembling and exporting video. Retain provisionally: YouTube-URL ingestion remains unverified; output integration does not prove input support, and silence does not justify exclusion.

rows.name: Flixier
rows.reason: Browser YouTube-URL import, trim/join and downloads documented; free 720p/watermark/10 exported minutes monthly. Ingestion untested; one YouTube page redirects generically, another live official page still confirms URLs.

rows.name: yt-dlp
rows.reason: Free CLI YouTube downloader feeds a desktop LosslessCut workflow, not visual editing itself. Section downloads need FFmpeg; trimming/concatenating selected sections still requires an editing/joining step.

rows.name: Cutlab
rows.reason: Cutlab offers free browser YouTube editing/export, untested. Fetching can fail; private, age-restricted and over-30-minute sources unsupported. Real-time export requires open tab; MP4 support varies, otherwise WebM.

rows.name: LosslessCut
rows.reason: LosslessCut trims/merges downloaded video without re-encoding. A separate downloader is required; cuts are rough, merging needs compatible codecs. Free manual downloads do not imply every store listing is free.

rows.name: Flixier
rows.reason: Flixier imports YouTube links for browser cutting/assembly and local export. Current free tier: ten export minutes/month, 720p, watermark, 2GB storage. Exact cutoff-date features/limits remain unverified.

rows.name: Kapwing
rows.reason: Browser timeline imports YouTube URLs, trims/reorders sections and downloads output. Current free exports: 720p, watermark, four-minute limit. Exact 2023-07-19 terms unestablished; no live edit/export tested.

rows.name: Adobe Premiere desktop (full subscription product)
rows.reason: Full desktop Adobe Premiere requires a paid monthly/annual subscription. A limited trial does not satisfy the free-tool requirement; this decisive constraint failure supports exclusion.

rows.name: DaVinci Resolve
rows.reason: The free desktop editor handles trimming, assembly and export; pair it with yt-dlp because direct YouTube-URL import was not verified.

rows.name: Cut/Storm
rows.reason: Provisional free self-hosted URL import/trimming with MP4 output. Arbitrary separated-section joining unestablished; documented editing is single-video. Default URL duration limit: 900 seconds. Docker setup adds work.

rows.name: WonderFox Free HD Video Converter Factory
rows.reason: Windows-only fallback combines YouTube-URL download, trimming, merging and local output. Use the Free edition; documentation postdates the question, and the workflow has not been executed.

rows.name: OpenSSH
rows.reason: SSH remote login, tunneling and file transfer do not supply an integrated video editor. Running a separate editor through SSH introduces the missing product rather than resolving the mismatch.

rows.name: OpenSSH
rows.reason: Its tools handle secure remote login and file transfer; they do not supply YouTube acquisition, video trimming, joining, or rendering.
